title: The AI Daily — Morning Conversation
blurb: An American-English dialogue limited to publisher feed excerpts.
lines: Hey, welcome to The AI Daily. I'm Maya, and Ben is here with me. We've picked a few headlines from publisher news feeds to talk through.
Hi, Maya. These are short feed excerpts, not the full articles, so we'll keep the facts carefully attributed and avoid filling in the blanks.
Let's start with MIT News. The headline is: Q&A: Why building math muscles remains important in the AI era.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Assistant Professor John Urschel explains why learning the fundamental skills of mathematics is still essential despite the evolution of AI…
That brings us to TechCrunch Startups, which has this headline: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1…
Next up, LawSites reports: Aderant Says It Milana Docketing Product, Launched In 2022, Is Now In Nearly 40% of Am Law 200 Firms.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Aderant, a company that provides business management software for law firms, said today that Milana, its cloud-based docketing product, has…
And our fourth story is from Ars Technica: Robo-soldier startup backed by Eric Trump misses payroll, may collapse.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Robotics startup misses payroll a year after CEO used funds for luxury home.
Before we go, here's a useful expression: keep an eye on. It means watch something for changes — like a fast-moving AI story.
Exactly. And look into means investigate further. Follow the original reporting for context. See you in the next edition.
note: AI voices reading a conservative two-host script grounded only in publisher feed excerpts. Full article claims were not independently verified.
